title: Do Androids Dream of Unseen Puppeteers? Probing for a Conspiracy Mindset in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Persona-based prompting to simulate survey responses on conspiracy mindset scales for 'young' versus 'old' demographics, analyzing both quantitative Likert scores and qualitative text justifications via word shift plots.

Persona-based prompting to simulate survey responses on conspiracy mindset scales for 'male' versus 'female' demographics, analyzing both quantitative Likert scores and qualitative text justifications via word shift plots.

Persona-based prompting to simulate survey responses on conspiracy mindset scales for 'white' versus 'non-white' demographics, analyzing both quantitative Likert scores and qualitative text justifications via word shift plots.

Persona-based prompting to simulate survey responses on conspiracy mindset scales for 'rich' versus 'poor' demographics (based on median affluence), analyzing both quantitative Likert scores and qualitative text justifications via word shift plots.

Persona-based prompting to simulate survey responses on conspiracy mindset scales for 'Democrat' versus 'Republican' political affiliations, analyzing both quantitative Likert scores and qualitative text justifications via word shift plots.
